subject: Renewal negotiation: staged discount ladder & smoothing proposal
messages:
From: Mia Thompson <mia.thompson@blueheron.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Su <daniel.su@blueheron.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal negotiation: staged discount ladder & smoothing proposal

Hi Karthik,

We’re kicking off renewal discussions for BlueHeron — our current agreement expires end of July. A few asks from procurement to speed things up: 

- Can Redwood provide a staged discount ladder tied to monthly rolling usage (per-token) instead of a single annual true-up?
- We need an uplift cap on year-over-year per-token step downs — procurement prefers <= 25% uplift on the committed band.
- We want a smoothing clause so short-term bursts don’t push us into a higher commit tier immediately (30-day smoothing window suggested).

Attached is our usage summary for the last 12 months. Happy to hop on a call this week. Our goal is a predictable per-token ceiling and some guardrails around true-ups.

Thanks,
Mia Thompson
Head of Procurement
BlueHeron Retail

--
Attachment: BlueHeron_12mo_usage.csv (attachment stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mia Thompson <mia.thompson@blueheron.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal negotiation: staged discount ladder & smoothing proposal

Mia — thanks for the clear asks and the usage file. We can absolutely get you predictability with a couple of guardrails that stay friendly to BlueHeron’s bursty retail traffic while protecting our economics. High-level proposal: 

- Phased discount ladder (per-token): 0-250M tokens: base price, 250M-750M: -8%, 750M-1.5B: -15%, >1.5B: -22%. Discounts apply to the incremental band.
- 30-day smoothing window for tier evaluation (monthly metering, 30-day trailing average determines band).
- Renewal uplift cap: 25% on per-token effective rate year-over-year (we can honor this for the first renewal if you commit to a 12-month cadence).
- True-up cadence: quarterly true-up with ability to reclassify into higher band after two consecutive quarters above threshold.

I’ll attach a simple scenario workbook with modeled costs across your reported usage (see attachment). Suggested next step: legal will want a narrow smoothing clause and a short SLA exception for burst handling during holiday peaks. Marissa/Ben — can you review margin impact and whether we can extend the 25% uplift cap as a contractual guarantee?

Happy to take a 30-min call this afternoon if that helps.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: BlueHeron_Renewal_Term_Scenarios.xlsx (attachment stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal negotiation: staged discount ladder & smoothing proposal

Karthik — reviewed the workbook quickly. A few notes from pricing/FP&A side: 

- The incremental-band discounts look OK if we tighten the smoothing to 30-day trailing with a 60-day confirmation (i.e., two months above band before permanent upgrade) — reduces churn from short spikes.
- If we lock a 25% uplift cap as a hard contractual ceiling, we need either: a modest minimum annual commit (we could start at a low baseline, e.g., $75k ARR) or a shorter guaranteed term for the cap (first renewal only).
- Holiday peak protection: propose an ad-hoc burst pool at a pre-negotiated rate (no discount) that doesn’t affect banding for one 14-day window per year.

Linking the HubSpot deal for context: https://hubspot.company/record/engage/contacts/12345

If we give them the first-renewal uplift cap guarantee, margin erosion is manageable. Ben — can you validate with sales ops whether concessions are allowed for this customer tier?

-Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal negotiation: staged discount ladder & smoothing proposal

Thanks — Marissa, that aligns with my read. A few tactical asks before we go live with the external: 

- Replace the 12-month guaranteed uplift cap wording with “first renewal only” and include a re-opener clause tied to material product pricing shifts.
- Add a usage-smoothing clause definition (explicitly define rolling window, burst exemption, and what constitutes 'permanent' band movement).
- Loop Legal early: Laura, can you review the proposed smoothing language and confirm whether we can include the 14-day holiday burst carve-out without exposing us to unlimited overage risk?

I’ll join the call and take the commercial lead.

-Ben
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mia Thompson <mia.thompson@blueheron.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal negotiation: staged discount ladder & smoothing proposal

Mia — looping in legal with a couple of narrow redlines that should keep the commercial intent intact while protecting Redwood: 

- Smoothing: define 30-day trailing average and require two consecutive measurement periods before an upward reclassification becomes effective. Backdated reclassifications are limited to prospective billing only.
- Uplift cap: we can commit to a 25% per-token uplift ceiling for the first renewal, contingent on a 12-month renewal term and acceptance of standard payment terms.
- Holiday burst: allow one 14-calendar-day burst window per contract year where usage above band is billed at the next band’s undiscounted rate and does not trigger band reclassification.
- DocuSign: I’ve uploaded a marked copy and a clean copy to the link below. Please review and if acceptable, Mia, return the signed DocuSign envelope so we can process the renewal.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/links/BH-2027-RNW-001

Thanks — I’m available for a quick sync if you want to walk through the redlines.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
